name: After § 11
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 11a. Calls for EU support to be given to Spain, particularly Ceuta, to reinforce physical border infrastructure, in particular through fences, concrete walls and other physical barriers, and to strengthen detention capacity and return capabilities;
